question: Does the 4090 pool that Dreamifly described in 2025 still serve any model at imagifly.net, or is the current site served from commercial GPU capacity?
why: The 2025-11-01 copy of dreamifly.com said its compute was '由全国30台家用电脑的闲置4090显卡' (the idle RTX 4090 cards of 30 home computers), free and unlimited. The current site sells credits across commercial models (GPT-Image-2.6, Nano Banana 2, Seedance) and states no hardware at all, so the distributed-pool claim cannot be carried forward on the present pages.
